Created `test/test_profile_seed.py` (the only file touched, nothing else modified) with three `@pytest.mark.banking` tests, and verified the RED state is exactly as specified.

**Results — `2 failed, 97 passed` (full suite; the other 97 stay green):**

| Test | Status | Reason |
|---|---|---|
| `test_seed_identity_is_picard` | FAILED | `AssertionError: seeded identity is Jean-Luc Picard` / `assert 'Demo User' == 'Jean-Luc Picard'` |
| `test_login_with_demo_still_works` | PASSED | login with `username: "demo"` already 302s to `/dashboard` |
| `test_profile_shows_picard_identity` | FAILED | `AssertionError: profile shows Picard identity per A1` — body renders `Demo User` / `demo@quantumbank.com` |

Notes on the implementation choices:
- The lock phrase `seeded identity is Jean-Luc Picard` appears in the source and in the failure output.
- Added a module-scoped autouse `models.init_db()` fixture (same pattern as the existing `test_profile_model.py`) so `test_seed_identity_is_picard` is standalone-runnable, since it takes no `client` fixture and the session temp DB would otherwise be unseeded.
- The address assertion uses the apostrophe-safe canary `b"USS Enterprise NCC-1701-D"`; confirmed from the rendered body that Jinja escapes `Captain's` to `Captain's`, so this substring will match once the seed is changed.
- Formatted to match black at line-length 88 and the repo's existing assertion-message style (`ruff`/`black` are not installed in `.venv`, so this was matched manually against neighboring test files).

The seed tuple at `models.py:431` is untouched, as required.
